krilla/

1/*!
2A high-level, ergonomic Rust library creating PDF documents.
3
4[krilla] is a high-level Rust crate that allows for the creation of PDF files. It builds
5on top of the [pdf-writer] crate, but abstracts away all complexities that are
6involved in creating a PDF file, instead providing an interface with high-level primitives, such
7as fills, strokes, gradient, glyphs and images which can be used and combined easily
8without having to worry about low-level details.
9
10To get started, take a look at the [`document`] module that explains how you can create
11a document using krilla.
12
13# Example
14
15The following example shows some of the features of krilla in action.
16
17The example creates a PDF file with two pages. On the first page,
18we add two small pieces of text, and on the second page we draw a triangle
19with a gradient fill.
20
21For more examples, feel free to take a look at the [examples] directory of the GitHub repository.
22
23```
24use std::path::{self, PathBuf};
25
26use krilla::color::rgb;
27use krilla::text::Font;
28use krilla::geom::{Point, PathBuilder};
29use krilla::paint::{SpreadMethod, LinearGradient, Stop, FillRule};
30use krilla::text::TextDirection;
31use krilla::paint::Fill;
32use krilla::Document;
33use krilla::page::PageSettings;
34use krilla::num::NormalizedF32;
35
36// Create a new document.
37let mut document = Document::new();
38// Load a font.
39let font = {
40    let path =
41        PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR")).join("../../assets/fonts/NotoSans-Regular.ttf");
42    let data = std::fs::read(&path).unwrap();
43    Font::new(data.into(), 0).unwrap()
44};
45
46// Add a new page with dimensions 200x200.
47let mut page = document.start_page_with(PageSettings::from_wh(200.0, 200.0).unwrap());
48// Get the surface of the page.
49let mut surface = page.surface();
50// Draw some text.
51surface.draw_text(
52    Point::from_xy(0.0, 25.0),
53    font.clone(),
54    14.0,
55    "This text has font size 14!",
56    false,
57    TextDirection::Auto
58);
59
60surface.set_fill(Some(Fill {
61    paint: rgb::Color::new(255, 0, 0).into(),
62    opacity: NormalizedF32::new(0.5).unwrap(),
63    rule: Default::default(),
64}));
65// Draw some more text, in a different color with an opacity and bigger font size.
66surface.draw_text(
67    Point::from_xy(0.0, 50.0),
68    font.clone(),
69    16.0,
70    "This text has font size 16!",
71    false,
72    TextDirection::Auto
73);
74
75// Finish the page.
76surface.finish();
77page.finish();
78
79// Start a new page.
80let mut page = document.start_page_with(PageSettings::from_wh(200.0, 200.0).unwrap());
81// Create the triangle.
82let triangle = {
83    let mut pb = PathBuilder::new();
84    pb.move_to(100.0, 20.0);
85    pb.line_to(160.0, 160.0);
86    pb.line_to(40.0, 160.0);
87    pb.close();
88
89    pb.finish().unwrap()
90};
91
92// Create the linear gradient.
93let lg = LinearGradient {
94    x1: 60.0,
95    y1: 0.0,
96    x2: 140.0,
97    y2: 0.0,
98    transform: Default::default(),
99    spread_method: SpreadMethod::Repeat,
100    stops: vec![
101        Stop {
102            offset: NormalizedF32::new(0.2).unwrap(),
103            color: rgb::Color::new(255, 0, 0).into(),
104            opacity: NormalizedF32::ONE,
105        },
106        Stop {
107            offset: NormalizedF32::new(0.8).unwrap(),
108            color: rgb::Color::new(255, 255, 0).into(),
109            opacity: NormalizedF32::ONE,
110        },
111    ],
112    anti_alias: false,
113};
114let mut surface = page.surface();
115
116// Set the fill.
117surface.set_fill(Some(Fill {
118    paint: lg.into(),
119    rule: FillRule::EvenOdd,
120    opacity: NormalizedF32::ONE
121}));
122
123// Fill the path.
124surface.draw_path(&triangle);
125
126// Finish up and write the resulting PDF.
127surface.finish();
128page.finish();
129
130let pdf = document.finish().unwrap();
131let path = path::absolute("basic.pdf").unwrap();
132eprintln!("Saved PDF to '{}'", path.display());
133
134// Write the PDF to a file.
135std::fs::write(path, &pdf).unwrap();
136```
137[krilla]: https://github.com/LaurenzV/krilla
138[pdf-writer]: https://github.com/typst/pdf-writer
139[examples]: https://github.com/LaurenzV/krilla/tree/main/crates/krilla/examples
140*/
